title: Diagnose and repair natural scheduled reconciliation timeout without synthetic closure

hosted_incident.observed_symptoms: Reconciliation scheduler ticks 1-10 failed with controller_status: unhealthy, evaluated_binding_count: 0, last_failure: timed out, last_success_at: null. In each tick, attempt 1 threw TimeoutError in scheduled_reconcile, while attempts 2 and 3 encountered DownstreamStatusError due to active lock contention from attempt 1.

root_cause_diagnosis.auth_failure: Ruled out. JWTs, service client tokens, and telemetry auth headers were valid; no HTTP 401 or 403 status codes were observed.
root_cause_diagnosis.missing_lifecycle_correlation: Ruled out. Natural signal runs 1-7 contained complete correlation envelopes and _paper_lifecycle_identity resolved without latency.
root_cause_diagnosis.transport_timeout: Confirmed. In _execute_scheduled_reconcile, downstream incident classification calls via _dispatch_scheduled_drift_report -> _classify_drift_report_incident -> _post_json synchronously used PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (110s in hosted compose, 90s default). Across 15-26 active bindings, any slow or unresponsive incidents response exceeded the scheduler worker's 90.0s socket timeout and 60.0s SLA budget, raising URLError('timed out').

hosted_incident.repair_strategy: Bound per-binding incident classification calls to min(5.0s, remaining_tick_budget) within the tick SLA deadline (sla_seconds - 5.0s). If the SLA budget is exhausted, return retryable_error (504) immediately rather than blocking downstream ticks, preserving tick completion and healthy controller status.

ac1_reproduce_natural_scheduler_boundary.detail: Reproduced transport timeout boundary vs auth failure and lifecycle correlation. Proven that synchronous unbounded incident dispatch in _post_json caused the 90s socket timeout in scheduler_worker.py.

ac2_exact_read_only_evidence.detail: Analyzed /tmp/pantheon-closure-continuation-20261007T1220Z/natural-run-boundaries.json, reconciliation-health.json, and /tmp/pantheon-closure-continuation-20261007T1255Z/scheduler-log-summary-nested.json confirming ticks 1-10 timeout patterns.

ac3_preserve_contracts_and_boundaries.detail: Preserved stable tick ID (scheduled:tenant-dev:<window>:PT300S), bounded idempotent retry semantics, existing authentication, and tenant scoping. No secondary store or controller added; no blanket timeout inflation or health suppression.

ac4_regression_coverage.detail: Added test_scheduled_reconcile_incident_dispatch_bounded_and_completes_within_sla in services/reconciliation-drift/tests/test_reconciliation_drift_scheduler.py verifying 15 active bindings, per-binding timeout <= 5.0s, SLA deadline enforcement, retryable error handling, and within_sla == True.

ac5_source_and_isolated_tests_only.detail: Changes restricted strictly to services/reconciliation-drift/main.py and its unit tests. Zero hosted mutations, DLQ replays, manual reconciliation injections, or state manipulations.

ac6_exact_head_review_and_external_wait.detail: Exact-head review file committed and bound for independent review by Claude. Hosted completion track remains external_wait until a new pair verifies end-to-end natural scheduled reconciliation.

ac7_root_cause_scope.detail: Root cause localized and remediated entirely within the reconciliation-drift service codebase.
